order_details.project_scope_summary: Food services / catering under Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Morning Breakfast Scheme to school children from common kitchen at Anupparpalayam Government Higher Secondary School premises, covering Wards 11, 31, 47 and 41

analysis.materiality_assessment: The order is highly material on a revenue basis. Its three-year value equals approximately 1.40 times the latest annual revenue, while the annualized value represents about 46.61% of annual revenue. It could materially improve revenue visibility and business growth if executed successfully. However, its earnings impact cannot be quantified because net profit, margins, payment terms and other commercial details are not disclosed.
analysis.risks: The order value is approximate and dependent on school working days. Catering contracts may have low or volatile margins. Payment cycle, advances, milestone billing, retention, bank guarantee and liquidated-damages terms are undisclosed. The required security deposit may increase working-capital needs. Execution, food-quality, supply-chain and municipal-client concentration risks are present. GST treatment is unclear, and the contract is limited to approximately three years with no renewal assurance.
analysis.rationale: The order is substantial relative to revenue and provides multi-year business visibility, but execution, margin and payment-term uncertainties prevent it from being classified as an Excellent Deal.
